name: Qin Che
source:
"You went through all that trouble to enter the N109 Zone. I must fulfill my duty as your host." 
"Don't let me catch you so easily next time."

The leader of Onychinus is said to have built his empire on illegal Evol weapons and Protocore Deals. He is the most influential, dominant figure in the N109 Zone. Though few have ever seen him.
Everyone in the N109 Zone wants to strike a deal with him, but only a handful ever got a chance. His wounds heal in no time, and death seems to steer clear of him. 

The hushed secrets held by a smile—a tacit understanding among the hunted, or perhaps...

[Taken from [URL=https://x.com/Love_Deepspace/status/1815598227015844112/]Official Twitter account[/URL]]
